name: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India)
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings runs events catering, casual dining restaurants (brands include India Bistro, China Bistro and Art of Dum), cloud kitchens and banquets in India and the UAE, led by promoter Sanjay Manohar Vazirani. Total income rose from ₹131 cr in FY22 to ₹380 cr in FY24, but profit swung between losses and small gains, with a ₹15.4 cr loss in FY24 and a ₹7.4 cr profit in the nine months to December 2024. The issue has a ₹160 cr fresh issue plus an offer for sale of about 1.2 crore shares; about 54% of the fresh money goes to new kitchens and restaurants and about 18% to repaying debt. The figures here come from the draft offer document; the price band and newer financials were not yet public when this report was written.

fh1.finding: Total income rose from ₹131.1 cr (FY22) to ₹380.2 cr (FY24), a CAGR of about 70%; FY25 and FY26 figures were not found.

fh2.finding: Total income grew in FY23 (₹275.8 cr) and FY24 (₹380.2 cr).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.37 at 31 Dec 2024 (borrowings ₹32.6 cr vs net worth ₹88.8 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose 74% (₹20.2 cr to ₹35.3 cr) while total income rose 190% over FY22–FY24.

fh5.finding: Net worth fell from ₹92.1 cr (FY23) to ₹79.6 cr (FY24) before recovering to ₹88.8 cr at Dec 2024.

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow figures were not found in public sources.

pr1.finding: The company made a loss of ₹15.4 cr in FY24 after a ₹2.7 cr profit in FY23.

pr2.finding: PAT margin was -4.04% in FY24, a loss-making year.

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was -17.88% in FY24.

pr4.finding: ROCE was not found in public sources.

pr5.finding: Public sources say there are no comparable listed peers in India.

va1.finding: The price band has not been announced and no listed peers are named, so P/E cannot be compared.

va2.finding: The price band has not been announced and no listed peers are named.

va3.finding: The price band has not been announced and no listed peers are named.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

is1.finding: The issue has a ₹160 cr fresh issue and an OFS of 1,19,53,535 shares, but the OFS value is unknown until the price band is set.

is2.finding: The issue size and post-issue market cap are not known until the price band is set.

is3.finding: Selling shareholders' acquisition cost was not found in public sources.

up1.finding: ₹86.3 cr (about 54% of the ₹160 cr fresh issue) goes to two centralised kitchens and four new restaurants.

up2.finding: ₹28.45 cr, or about 17.8% of the fresh issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

up3.finding: The general corporate purposes amount was not stated in public sources.

up4.finding: Whether any repaid loans are from promoter entities was not found.
